articles.title: Bitcoin buyers wary of July sub-$58K floor amid onchain data ‘anomaly’
articles.description: Bitcoin HODL waves data revealed an unusually muted reaction to Bitcoin’s drop below $58,000, raising questions over its status as a bear-market floor.

articles.title: Standard Chartered forecasts SKY rising fivefold to $0.325 by 2028
articles.description: The bank expects Sky to pass five times as much value to token holders by 2028 as USDS adoption and borrowing capacity continue to expand.

articles.title: India launches tokenized bond pilot with $107M issued
articles.description: SEBI said later phases of Demat 2.0 will introduce secondary trading and open the tokenized bonds to retail investors.

articles.title: Anthropic says Claude used for cyberattacks and surveillance
articles.description: A Russian-speaking operator targeted more than 20 organizations, while a Mali consultant used Claude to build a mass-surveillance platform.

articles.title: Blockstream rejects ransom as Liquid hackers hold nearly 600 BTC
articles.description: Blockstream said it would work with law enforcement, exchanges and forensic specialists to recover the Bitcoin if the hackers do not return it.

articles.title: Bitwise to put down Dogecoin ETF less than a year after launch
articles.description: BWOW held about $688,000 in net assets as of Sept. 9. Trading is expected to end Oct. 14, with cash payouts to follow around Oct. 22.

articles.title: SBF asks Supreme Court to overturn conviction, $11B forfeiture: Report
articles.description: Bankman-Fried’s lawyers challenged the exclusion of evidence about customer losses and argued that his $11 billion forfeiture was excessive.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Revised CLARITY Act targets ‘non-decentralized’ DeFi operators
articles.description: The bill’s ethics section remained largely unchanged despite being one of the main points of contention ahead of a pivotal Senate vote.

articles.title: Brevo login flaw enabled phishing email targeting 347K Trezor subscribers
articles.description: Trezor told Cointelegraph that the phishing email was sent to 347,000 subscribers and said it is treating every address as “known to the attacker and possibly reusable for phishing.”

articles.title: Metaplanet equity backlash, SE Asia crypto funding doubles: Asia Express
articles.description: Shareholders of Bitcoin treasury company Metaplanet are seething over equity allocations for insiders, while new figures cement Singapore’s role as the top Asian crypto hub.

articles.title: ESMA warns growing crypto ties could amplify risks to traditional finance
articles.description: The EU securities regulator flagged tokenized equities, DeFi exploits and prediction markets as areas where growing crypto ties could pose risks to the broader financial system.

articles.title: UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour position
articles.description: The amendment would require the UK Treasury to develop a strategy covering cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized securities and digital financial infrastructure.

articles.title: Liquid Network resumes block production after $320M exploit
articles.description: Liquid restarted block production after deploying emergency software updates, though transactions and peg operations remain suspended as recovery efforts continue.

articles.title: MoneyGram launches Visa stablecoin card as remittance rivals expand
articles.description: MoneyGram is following rival Western Union’s lead, rolling out a Visa stablecoin debit card as it expands blockchain-based payments.

articles.title: EU finance groups push to remove tokenized securities cap
articles.description: European finance and tokenization groups say Brussels should remove limits on assets admitted to DLT infrastructure or set a 1.5 trillion euro baseline if a cap remains.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls on US PPI overshoot as 30-year bond yield hits new 19-year high
articles.description: Bitcoin fell with US stocks as high inflation and a further surge in oil prices coincided with another multidecade high for US bond yields.

articles.title: Coinbase, Moov to provide stablecoin infrastructure for US community banks
articles.description: The partnership will provide stablecoin acceptance, settlement and real-time funding capabilities to over 1,000 community banks and credit unions.

articles.title: Solana sees record 263K tokens issued in a single day
articles.description: Memecoin platform Pump.fun accounted for most of the new tokens among launchpads, as the Solana network notched a new all-time daily issuance high.

articles.title: Ex-BoE deputy governor headlines trio of former central bankers joining Fnality
articles.description: Jon Cunliffe, Jochen Metzger and Ron Berndsen join Fnality Europe’s supervisory board as the company works to expand beyond its sterling payment system.

articles.title: Nasdaq invests $100M in Kraken parent at $21B valuation: Report
articles.description: Nasdaq invested $100 million in Payward as part of its push toward tokenized stock products with round-the-clock trading.

articles.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent urges CLARITY Act passage after Senate returns
articles.description: Secretary Scott Bessent warned that failing to pass the CLARITY Act would send a “troubling signal” about America’s leadership in the digital asset industry.

articles.title: Hunter Biden denies profiting from memecoin after his LAPTOP crashes
articles.description: Nansen found a $117,800 unrealized loss in one wallet as the team announced liquidity incentives and Bubblemaps flagged fresh top holders.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $167M after strongest three-week inflow run of 2026
articles.description: ARKB led Wednesday’s Bitcoin ETF outflows as Ether and Solana funds returned to net inflows.

articles.title: Bitcoin sell-side risk returns to rare lows as $80K sellers fade from view
articles.description: Bitcoin investors showed little sign of panic selling as BTC held most of its August gains and sell-side risk fell to rare lows, data showed.

articles.title: India’s Arya.ag to put grain ownership records on Avalanche
articles.description: The system will combine farmer, grain, warehouse, insurance and loan data for lenders, though no launch date or initial deployment size was disclosed.

articles.title: Unicoin sues Uniswap Labs, seeks to cancel UNI registration
articles.description: The complaint says Uniswap’s counsel sent three letters before Unicoin’s Sept. 28 launch and seeks declarations on its marks and domains.

articles.title: Trezor, BitBox warn users about fake hardware wallet security alerts
articles.description: BitBox said multiple Bitcoin companies appeared to have been targeted through a shared newsletter provider, while Trezor confirmed a breach at its email service.

articles.title: US sanctions Xinbi scam marketplace, restrains $52M in crypto
articles.description: The Justice Department seized Xinbi’s Telegram channels and two wallets as investigators pursued 47 additional wallets across its alleged laundering network.

articles.title: DoubleZero adds Kalshi election market data ahead of US midterms
articles.description: The expansion gives institutional and automated traders real-time access to Kalshi’s political markets as election betting activity continues to grow.
